findings.title: Truthful current harness review is unconditionally refused
findings.body: admit() asserts review.harness.path equals native-ngram-channels.mjs although the current harness and review contract require native-head-cdn-workflow.mjs. A truthful future direct review cannot be admitted. Correct the one basename; preserve the SHA and manifest checks.

findings.title: Intentional table scrolling is misclassified as page overflow
findings.body: bounds() tests every non-mainnav button against document.clientWidth using getClientRects(). D3 app.js renders real sort buttons inside .table-scroll{overflow:auto}; clipped table headers still have client rects and intentionally lie beyond the viewport at320. Verify real scroll reachability/restoration inside the exact table container separately rather than requiring all its columns simultaneously onscreen or broadly excluding ordinary controls.

findings.title: Cold screenshots overwrite warm evidence
findings.body: bounds() writes label-width.png for both warm and cold phases into the same downloads directory, including header, head-inspector, raw-dom-inspector, cdn-inspector and legacy-inspector. Use distinct warm/cold names and retain actual screenshot SHA/bytes at capture time; do not overwrite evidence.

observations.body: bounds(cdn-settings,320) still performs fullPage screenshot before a real Save, matching the suspected influence in the separately reproduced Static diagnostic2162. V4 viewport-only/passive-hit diagnostic1977 review is ready but not yet executed. Resolve this evidence before native execution; no product or oracle weakening is justified yet.

Binder path spellings and SHA/bytes are equal in actual Driver13V2 manifest and PINNED refs; no E:/ versus E:\ deepEqual mismatch observed. The historical Source12 suite/build/current aliases are rejected; Source13 future values remain mandatory actual grant inputs.
